articles.text: ZHÀNGFU: Xiùyín, nǐ huílai le. Jīntian zěnme zhème wǎn?
HUSBAND: Xiùyín, you're back. How come you're so late tonight?
XIÙYÍN: Xiàle bānr, wǒ yòu qù mǎi diǎnr yào.
XIÙYÍN: After work I went to buy some medicine.
ZHÀNGFU: Wǒ xiǎng wǒ yǐjing hǎo le, hái mǎi shénme yào?
HUSBAND: I think I've already recovered. What are you buying medicine for?
XIÙYÍN: Nǐ cái yìtiān bù fā shāo, jiù shuō hǎo le? Kuài yìdiǎnr bǎ zhèi liǎngzhǒng yào dōu chīxiaqu.
XIÙYÍN: Your fever has only been gone for one day and you say you've recovered? Come on and take these two medicines.
ZHÀNGFU: Wǒ nǎr xūyào zhème duō yào!
HUSBAND: As if I needed all this medicine!
XIÙYÍN: Zhèizhǒng gǎnmào bú shi yìtiān liǎngtiān jiù huì hǎode, nǐ yídìng děi bǎ zhèi jǐzhǒng yào dōu chīle.
XIÙYÍN: This kind of cold doesn't get better in just a day or two. You have to take all of these medicines.
ZHÀNGFU: Hǎo hǎo hǎo, wǒ chī.
HUSBAND: Okay, okay, I'll take them.
XIÙYÍN: Wǒ qù gěi ni dào bēi rèshuǐ lai, xiànzài jiù chī.
XIÙYÍN: I'll get you a cup of hot water, and you take them right now.
ZHÀNGFU: Ēi, shuōdào chī yào, wǒ jiù xiǎngqilai le. Nǐ hái jìde shínián qián, zánmen zài Qīnghǎi xiāngxià kànjiande nèijiàn shì ma?
HUSBAND: Say, speaking of taking medicine reminds me — do you remember what we saw out in the country of Qīnghǎi ten years ago?
XIÙYÍN: Zěnme bú jìde, zánmen dōu shi zuò yīshēngde, kànjian bìngrén méi yào chī, zhēn nánshòu.
XIÙYÍN: How could I forget. We're both doctors; seeing sick people without medicine to take was really upsetting.
ZHÀNGFU: Kěshi, hái yǒu rén shuō zhèizhǒng qíngxing méi guānxi, fǎnzhèng Zhōngguo rén duō, zhēn shi bù jiǎng dàolǐ!
HUSBAND: But you know what some people say? They say that this sort of situation doesn't matter, that there are plenty of Chinese anyway. It makes no sense at all!
XIÙYÍN: Hài! Nèige shíhou, shénme qíguàide shìr dōu yǒu, bié shuō le.
XIÙYÍN: (Sigh) Back then, there were all sorts of strange things; don't talk about it any more.
ZHÀNGFU: Kěyi bù shuō, kěshi bú huì wàng. Zhōngguó yǒu jǐyì rén, chénglǐ rén yě hǎo, xiāngxià rén yě hǎo, yǒu bìng bù néng kàn yīshēng, yǒu bìng méi yào chīde shì, zài yě bù néng yǒu le.

HUSBAND: We don't have to talk about it, but we won't forget. There are several hundred million people in China. Whether it's people in the city or people in the country, we can't have any more situations where people are sick and yet unable to see a doctor or get medicine.
XIÙYÍN: Nǐ shuōde duì. Hǎo le, hǎo le, nǐde bìng cái hǎo yìdiǎnr, nǐ chīle yào zǎo diǎnr xiūxi ba.
XIÙYÍN: You're right. Okay, your illness is only a little better; after you take your medicine go to bed early.
ZHÀNGFU: Wǒ xiān bǎ yào chīle, děng yìhuǐr, wǒ hái děi chūqu yítàng. Yīyuànli hái yǒu jǐjiàn shì děi bàn, wǒ qù kàn yíxià jiù huílai.
HUSBAND: I'll take the medicine now, but I have to go out again in a while. I still have a few things I have to take care of at the hospital. I'll be back right after I go take a look there.
XIÙYÍN: Zǎo diǎnr huílai!
XIÙYÍN: Don't come back too late!
